info.+content: Long ago, the "fairies" who once existed vanished, leaving behind only fossils known as "Wands". Those capable of wielding the power hidden within these Wands came to be known as "Fairy Users." In a world where humans and Fairy Users coexist, Arata lives a bitter life, treated as an outcast. One day, a mysterious and melancholic girl named Misa appears before him. Their encounter sets their lives in motion, leading to an adventure bound for the "Fairy Graveyard", a legendary land where countless Wands lie dormant. So begins an epic tale of battle, fantasy, and exploration.
